$schema_note: Copy this file to <product-repo>/.claude/agents.config.json and fill in the values. Every agent reads this at the start of its run to know which product it is working on.
stack_hints: React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, PostHog for analytics, Sentry for errors. Mobile-first. iOS + Android.
design_voice: warm, calm, trustworthy — healthcare-adjacent audience. Generous whitespace, large tap targets, WCAG AA minimum.
speed_bias: prefer smaller, reversible changes over larger, robust ones — speed of learning > completeness of solution

designer.extra_constraints: Healthcare-appropriate. Large touch targets (min 44pt). Low-vision considerations. Avoid clinical sterility — should feel like a calm companion, not a medical chart.
